habits.label: Takes the strategy card
habits.what: Share of strategic decisions where one of the two strategy cards (Aggressive or Conservative) was committed as offered, rather than an allocation built or edited by hand.

habits.label: Goes manual before the cards load
habits.what: Of the decisions made by hand, the share committed before the strategy cards had even appeared (undefined in a session with no hand-made decisions).

habits.label: Edits a card instead of taking it
habits.what: Share of strategic decisions where a card was opened as the starting point but its drone counts were changed before committing.

habits.label: Presses Suggest on tactical plans
habits.what: Share of tactical plans where the operator pressed Suggest at least once to see the Tactical Assistant's drone-to-task plan.

habits.label: Keeps the Suggest plan unchanged
habits.what: Of the plans where Suggest was pressed, the share deployed exactly as suggested, with no change.

habits.label: Presses Suggest in recovery
habits.what: Share of recovery episodes (after a drone failure or lockout) where Suggest was pressed (undefined in a session with no recovery).

habits.label: Time spent per strategic decision
habits.what: Median time per strategic decision, from the strategic window opening to the choice, minus the forced wait while the cards load (analysed on a log scale).

habits.label: Drones vs card, single-type missions
habits.what: On missions that need a single drone type: average drones committed minus the Conservative card's total (+1 = one drone more than the cautious card).

habits.label: Drones vs card, multi-type missions
habits.what: The same on missions that need two or three drone types.

habits.label: Previews cards before choosing
habits.what: Average number of times per strategic decision a card was highlighted (previewed) before choosing.
